Claim_Text: True independent external validation on PhysioNet Set B
Evidence: Set B is from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (Boston, MA) vs Set A from Emory University Hospital (Atlanta, GA). Programmatic overlap = 0 patients (0.00%).
Different hospital systems in different US states with independent patient registries.
Brier score (0.01720) and ECE (0.0041) are excellent, but calibration slope (0.4952) shows over-confidence on extreme tail probabilities.
Top feature categories (Heart Rate, MAP Delta, Temp, WBC, Shock Index) are identical, but exact order among minor features has a Spearman rank correlation of 0.942.

Claim_Text: Measurement-density failure mode explains sensitivity drop
Evidence: Subgroup audit confirms patients with low measurement density (<0.8 vitals/h) suffer a severe sensitivity reduction (54.90% vs 72.10%).
Confirmation PPV was 32.14% on Set A and 35.82% on Set B, preserving bedside alarm precision.
Median lead time is 40.0 hours prior to clinical onset on Set B (vs 36.0 hours on Set A).
